{{Quote|Now get your ''shebs'' into that cantina and show me you remember how to order ''ne'tra gal'' and a meal.|[[Parja Bralor]]|<ref name="O66" />}}
A '''cantina''' was located in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Enceri]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. An old and worn establishment, the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina's]] black-[[Color/Legends|colored]] doors were the only parts of the building's exterior that appeared well-maintained by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Inside, tables and chairs were spread about for patrons to sit at, and both [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and drink could be ordered from the cantina's long bar. As Enceri was a small town, the cantina's patrons were largely well-acquainted regulars. The cantina was staffed by an elderly [[Unidentified female bartender|female bartender]], and served mugs of black [[Black ale/Legends|''ne'tra gal'']] [[Ale/Legends|ale]], in addition to bowls of soup—either [[Fish/Legends|''gi'']] [[Gi dumpling soup|dumpling]], or [[Red gourd soup|red gourd]].<ref name="O66" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] couple [[Parja Bralor]] and [[Fi Skirata]] traveled to Enceri as part of the latter's rehabilitation from a [[Battle of Gaftikar|head injury]]. After Bralor helped the wounded former [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] navigate Enceri's streets, the two stopped in at the cantina for a meal and [[Alcohol/Legends|drinks]]. Skirata's attempts at ordering from the bar in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] earned him odd looks from the elderly [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]]—Enceri residents primarily spoke the Mandalorian [[Language/Legends|language]], [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']]—until the older [[Gender/Legends|woman]] saw the [[Mir'shupur sigil|sigils denoting disability]] on Skirata's [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], after which she spoke to him in a gentler and more helpful tone. Skirata ordered two mugs of ''ne'tra gal'' and two bowls of red [[Vegetable/Legends|gourd]] soup for Bralor and himself, and they enjoyed a table together in a corner of the cantina. Their time together was interrupted, however, by the arrival of fellow Mandalorian [[Fenn Shysa]], who introduced himself to Skirata and attempted to enlist him in acting as [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] in the interim until one could be truly chosen, a proposition he would later elaborate upon at a second meeting in the ''[[Oyu'baat]]'' [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcaf]] in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]].<ref name="O66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Enceri cantina first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2008]] novel ''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]'', by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]].
